purpose: Provide the derived multi-floor topology used by the V6 building-specific counterfactual route-guidance screen.

source_evidence.evidence_type: author-reviewed building egress drawings and derived room-location inputs

topology_rule: Declared egress routes establish corridor and stair connectivity. Each room attaches to the nearest declared corridor node under the documented topology-construction rule.
accessibility_rule: The two final exits marked accessible in the derived input are available to IWD route planning.
vertical_transfer_rule: Each declared west/east stair link uses a fixed 14-s transfer time in the counterfactual screen.
world_layout_rule: Floor drawings are separated in a computational world frame to prevent artificial cross-floor social forces. Declared vertical links transfer agents between layers.
